notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 and macOS
notes.content:
[h2]There is now a macOS version![/h2][p]Some of few may have noticed that the demo is now available for macOS! I hadn't announced anything yet as I was testing things out and was planning to add a few fixes while at it. [/p][p][b]Though the macOS is available, I haven't had the chance to try to run it on older macOS devices.[/b] If you happen to run into any problems, feel free to let me know!
[/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]macOS: There were issues with the double click as macOS seems to not register double clicks the same way and stopped from continuously double clicking blocks to rotate them easily.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor UI stuff[/p][list][*][p]Some settings weren't being saved properly.[/p][/*][*][p]The scrolling on menus didn't work properly when using sliders.[/p][/*][*][p]Small graphical stuff. Probably wouldn't have been noticeable. But I noticed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]QOL Changes[/h3][list][*][p]It's now also possible to click Elfie's thought bubble to start the dialogue. \[[i]EDIT: This may have not made it in.[/i]][/p][/*][*][p]Space Bar added to be able to continue Elfie's dialogue. Currently it's not possible to remap it but I'll be working on adding that feature to the General options for release and possibly updating it in the demo too.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: There is now a macOS version!

tags.bug: macOS: There were issues with the double click as macOS seems to not register double clicks the same way and stopped from continuously double clicking blocks to rotate them easily.
Some settings weren't being saved properly.
The scrolling on menus didn't work properly when using sliders.

tags.feature: It's now also possible to click Elfie's thought bubble to start the dialogue.
Space Bar added to be able to continue Elfie's dialogue.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content: [h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]When going to the Credits when pausing the game, the player would stay stuck there and have to force quit the game. That should be fixed now.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Modified the hit boxes for the triangular shapes and the stairs. It should be easier to pickup blocks that are behind them and make selecting the block you want to pickup behind other blocks more accurate.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Language[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed some Japanese translations that we're mismatch.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: When going to the Credits when pausing the game, the player would stay stuck there and have to force quit the game. That should be fixed now.

tags.balance_change: Modified the hit boxes for the triangular shapes and the stairs. It should be easier to pickup blocks that are behind them and make selecting the block you want to pickup behind other blocks more accurate.

tags.bug: Fixed some Japanese translations that we're mismatch.
